chunks: Rijal al-Kashshi: Muhammad ibn Qulawayh, from Sa'd ibn Abdallah ibn Abi Khalaf al-Qummi, from Ahmad ibn Muhammad ibn Isa, from Abdallah ibn Muhammad al-Hajjal, from al-Ala ibn Razin, from Abdallah ibn Abi Ya'fur who said:

I said to Abu Abdillah (peace be upon him): 'It is not every hour that I meet you, and it may be impossible to travel [to reach you]. A man from among our companions comes and asks me, but I do not have [an answer] for everything that he asks me about [what should I do?].' He (peace be upon him) said: 'What prevents you from [going to] Muhammad ibn Muslim al-Thaqafi, for he had heard [narrations] from my father and had a most favorable position with him.'

key_terms.الثَّقَفِيُّ: Al-Thaqafi, a tribal nisba indicating Muhammad ibn Muslim's lineage
key_terms.مُحَمَّدُ بْنُ مُسْلِمٍ: Muhammad ibn Muslim, a prominent companion of the Imams
key_terms.وَجِيهًا: A person of high status, respect, or reliability

ai.seo_question: Who did the Imams recommend as a reliable source for religious knowledge when they were not personally available?
ai.summary: Imam al-Sadiq (peace be upon him) recommends Muhammad ibn Muslim al-Thaqafi as a primary reference for companions who cannot frequently visit him, highlighting the institutionalization of hadith transmission through trusted deputies. This narration underscores the scholarly status of Muhammad ibn Muslim as a key link in the chain of transmission from the Prophet’s family, validating his authority in answering religious queries on behalf of the Imam.

en.ammaar-muslim: 1. [1/175] Rijal al-Kashshi: Muhammad b. Qulawayh from Sa’d b. Abdallah b. Abi Khalaf al-Qummi from Ahmad b. Muhammad b. Isa from Abdallah b. Muhammad al-Hajjal from al-Ala b. Razin from Abdallah b. Abi Ya’fur who said:

I said to Abi Abdillah عليه السلام – I cannot meet you at all times and it may be impossible to travel [to reach you], it happens that a man from among our companions comes and asks me – but I do not have something [an answer] for everything that he asks me about [what should I do?]. He عليه السلام said: What prevents you from [going to] Muhammad b. Muslim al-Thaqafi – for he had heard [narrations] from my father and had a most favorable position with him.
